paragraphs.text: The Videnthian Sea is a body of water separating the Terisian Isles and Greater Videnth .

The Videnthian Sea is the part of the Dominarian ocean that lies east and northeast of the Terisian Isles (former Terisiare ). The Videnthian Sea is named after the large polar continent of Upper Videnth , which lies northeast across the sea from Terisiare . The Videnthian Sea connects to the Endless Sea in the west, the Sea of Laments in the southwest, the Visceral Sea in the southeast, and the Shattered Sea in the south.

The Videnthian Sea bordered the eastern coasts of Terisiare before that continent was split into smaller islands. During the Brothers' War the sea ran along the northern parts of the Sardian Mountains . During the Dark Age , the Videnthian Sea started forming icebergs, and whole sheets of ice formed in the northernmost parts coming off Videnth itself. During the Ice Age , the ice floes coalesced into massive ice caps, with glacial spurs running onto the continent itself. This effectively connected Terisiare with the larger Videnth, forming one frozen supercontinent.
